scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @team-arcade/web && npm run build --workspace @team-arcade/worker
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:worker
scripts.test:worker: npm run build --workspace @team-arcade/web && vitest run --config apps/worker/vitest.config.ts
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/shared/tsconfig.json --pretty false && tsc -p packages/game-core/tsconfig.json --pretty false && tsc -p packages/games/tsconfig.json --pretty false && tsc -p apps/web/tsconfig.json --pretty false && tsc -p apps/worker/tsconfig.json --pretty false && tsc -p tests/e2e/tsconfig.json --pretty false
